description: Single-DGX-Spark NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (Mamba-2, attention and MoE hybrid) on Ash Hart's TensorFold engine v0.6.6 (exact decoding, custom CUDA kernels JIT-compiled on first start, stock upstream source) with Vontra's MLX 4-bit (group 64) checkpoint, which includes the model's MTP draft head. One rank only: TensorFold's two-rank mode is not available here. Requests are served one at a time (upstream CUDA behaviour for Nemotron) in TensorFold's default 16,384-token window; raise the context setting for longer prompts, up to the model's 262,144 tokens, subject to TensorFold's startup memory check. Upstream measured about 123 to 146 tok/s with MTP and a 42.2 GiB peak at 262,144 tokens on a 64 GB M5 Pro, an MLX run with TensorFold 0.3.5.1; no DGX Spark figure is published, and none is measured here. Licence, for information: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning weights are under the OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 (text in the model repository); TensorFold is Apache-2.0 from 0.6.0 (MIT up to 0.5.0). TensorFold v0.6.6 at cb2ebf0540f42604e2759b2ddef497861e928248, the newest release of TensorFold's Python engine line (0.6; TensorFold 1.x is a native binary that serves only Nemotron on CUDA), keeps every option this recipe passes. Per upstream's release notes it runs CUDA prompts at bf16 by default and serves Prometheus /metrics, and resumes an identical resend or the next thinking turn on Nemotron; the existing context bound and one-stream resource profile are retained. From 0.6.1 to 0.6.6 upstream's release notes add, among others, the Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages), optional API keys (not set here), /v1/decisions scoring and joint prefill of prompts that wait together when concurrency is above 1. Since 0.6.5 Nemotron on CUDA drafts up to 15 MTP levels by default, each chain stopping where the next verify row would cost more than its draft saves (costs measured at startup; upstream claims about 6 percent faster decoding on one DGX Spark, unmeasured here); the recipe's default follows that, and the fixed-depth choices remain. The pinned ARM64 image includes xgrammar 0.2.8 and Apache TVM FFI 0.1.11 for OpenAI response_format structured-output requests. Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Open a think block by default (upstream default: --thinking).
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B TensorFold single Spark
